description: This header file declares functions related to managing command property and argument structures for the Bmc2 environment, including cleanup and deallocation functions.

methods.name: Bmc2CleanCommandProperty
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a command property object.

methods.name: Bmc2FreeCommandProperty
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a command property object.

methods.name: Bmc2CleanCmdArgument
methods.description: Cleans up a command argument structure.

methods.name: Bmc2FreeCmdArgument
methods.description: Frees memory for a command argument structure.

methods.name: Bmc2CleanCmdDepArg
methods.description: Cleans a command dependent argument structure.

methods.name: Bmc2CleanCmdDepArgBranch
methods.description: Cleans a branch of a dependent command argument.

methods.name: Bmc2CleanCmdSimpleArg
methods.description: Cleans a simple command argument structure.

methods.name: Bmc2CleanCmdArgValueRange
methods.description: Cleans a command argument value range structure.

methods.name: Bmc2FreeCmdArgValueRange
methods.description: Frees memory for a command argument value range.

methods.name: Bmc2FreeCmdHelpSyntax
methods.description: Frees syntax information for command help.
